name: Crash guard
description: Remembers every open pane (folder, agent, conversation, resume command) once a minute. When herdr restarts and sessions vanish, a banner offers to reopen them in the right workspace and resume each one.

keep.label: Snapshots to keep
keep.hint: A new one is saved when your panes change; old ones rotate out

atOnce.label: Sessions restored at once
atOnce.hint: Each waits for its shell to start, so keep this small

minLost.label: Sessions that must vanish to call it a crash
